احتشمت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَمْتُ (iḥtašamtu) /iħ.ta.ʃam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# اِحْتَشَمْتَ (iḥtašamta) /iħ.ta.ʃam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# اِحْتَشَمْتِ (iḥtašamti) /iħ.ta.ʃam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# اِحْتَشَمَتْ (iḥtašamat) /iħ.ta.ʃa.mat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
